class ListNode:
    def __init__(self, v): self.val = v; self.next = None
def build_list(a):
    dummy = ListNode(0); t = dummy
    for x in a: t.next = ListNode(x); t = t.next
    return dummy.next
def ser_list(h):
    o = []
    while h: o.append(h.val); h = h.next
    return o
def build_cycle(a, pos):
    dummy = ListNode(0); t = dummy; cyc = None
    for i, x in enumerate(a):
        t.next = ListNode(x); t = t.next
        if i == pos: cyc = t
    if pos >= 0 and t: t.next = cyc
    return dummy.next
def solve(vals, pos):
    head=build_cycle(vals,pos); slow=head; fast=head; cyc=False
    while fast and fast.next:
        slow=slow.next; fast=fast.next.next
        if slow is fast: cyc=True; break
    if not cyc: return -1
    slow=head
    while slow is not fast:
        slow=slow.next; fast=fast.next
    i=0; n=head
    while n is not slow: n=n.next; i+=1
    return i

class TreeNode:

        self.val = val
        self.left = None

        return None
    root = TreeNode(int(tokens[0]))
    q = deque([root])
    i = 1
    while q and i < len(tokens):
        node = q.popleft()
        if i < len(tokens) and tokens[i] != "null":
            node.left = TreeNode(int(tokens[i]))
            q.append(node.left)
        i += 1
        if i < len(tokens) and tokens[i] != "null":
            node.right = TreeNode(int(tokens[i]))
            q.append(node.right)
        i += 1
    return root

    while st:
        t = st.pop()
        if x <= t.val <= y:
            total += t.val

class TreeNode:

        self.val = val
        self.left = None
        self.right = None

def build(tokens):
    if not tokens or tokens[0] == "null":
        return None
    root = TreeNode(int(tokens[0]))
    q = deque([root])
    i = 1
    while q and i < len(tokens):
        node = q.popleft()
        if i < len(tokens) and tokens[i] != "null":
            node.left = TreeNode(int(tokens[i]))
            q.append(node.left)
        i += 1
        if i < len(tokens) and tokens[i] != "null":
            node.right = TreeNode(int(tokens[i]))
            q.append(node.right)
        i += 1
    return root

L = sys.stdin.read().split('\n')

def solve(root, x, y):
    path_to = {}

    def walk(node, path):
        if node is None:
            return
        path = path + [node.val]
        path_to[node.val] = path
        walk(node.left, path)
        walk(node.right, path)

    walk(root, [])
    target = path_to[x]
    out = []
    for v, path in path_to.items():
        common = 0
        while common < min(len(path), len(target)) and path[common] == target[common]:

        if (len(path) - common) + (len(target) - common) == y:

        seen = [False] * n

        self.left = None
